name: observed_white_opening_positions
source_grain: checked source snapshot × provider × game ID × White decision ply
analysis_grain: visit snapshot × cohort × optional recorded opening family × canonical position
position_key: Piece placement, side to move, castling rights, and en passant only if legal; first four normalized FEN fields. SHA-256 truncated to 24 hex characters; retained key and collision check.
history: Full FEN, full UCI prefix and repeated-position flag remain in local visit shards. Draw counters and repetition history are not part of the recognition key.
game_count: A game contributes once per canonical position within the window; the earliest visit supplies its route and continuation.
frequency: Distinct games reaching the position / all eligible games in that cohort and, when selected, recorded opening family. Not a personal encounter estimate.
opening_family: Recorded game opening tag before its first colon. ECO is retained separately. Labels do not define or merge board positions.
recurring: At least two distinct games reach the exact position.
acyclic_route_count: Distinct complete UCI arrival prefixes with no repeated canonical position anywhere in that prefix. Looped prefixes are counted in game frequency but not in this route count.
transposing: At least two distinct acyclic arrival prefixes reach the exact position.
ranking: Descending distinct-game count, with position ID as deterministic tie breaker; up to 20 recurring and 20 transposing positions per view.
route_share: Games with this earliest arrival prefix / position games; up to three non-looped examples are published, so displayed shares need not sum to one.
continuation_share: Games choosing this legal next White move at the earliest visit / position games, including games without a next move in the denominator. Report next_move_games separately. Up to five moves are published.
top_set_coverage: Union of distinct games encountering any top-10 or top-20 position / eligible view games. Overlapping position frequencies must not be added.
endpoint_compression: At a fixed ply, 1 − distinct canonical endpoint positions / distinct UCI prefixes. Exclude any prefix with a repeated canonical position. Descriptive convergence, not a measured learning benefit.
publication: Separate Elite and broader public cohorts. Publish all opening-family inventory counts, plus all-opening rankings and up to twelve largest known families with at least 1000 eligible games. Local hashes bind retained inputs, extraction plan, parser implementation and artifacts.
limits: Elite is a curated November 2025 month; public sources are nine ordered first-day archive prefixes. Frequency is not move quality, strategic importance, or causal evidence. No engine scoring, personal weighting, drills, or live provider requests.
